archive_scanning: Archive names and decompressed members are scanned recursively; compressed binary byte coincidences are not textual identifiers.

audited_sources: Hugging Face constants and transformers hub

clean_preflight.method: Fresh environment; native libc writable-open audit, Python file mutation audit and complete public-tree inventory checked against a fixed allowlist
clean_preflight.scope: Actual CPU runtime with tiny authenticated export and processor/RGB/head-shape doubles; real finalize and fetch

cache_isolation.inactive_overrides: The allowlist drops STUDENT_KERNEL_CACHE_ROOT/TAG and STUDENT_MEMORY_PROBE_CACHE, so optional persistent kernel/probe overrides cannot replace the job-local paths.
cache_isolation.lifetime: The assigned ext4 job_tmp is owned and removed by Orchard job teardown. Cache files are excluded from all return/fetch member lists and are never copied to /project.
cache_isolation.namespace: Only the job root is bound at its /tmp path; the worker cannot see /project. Other writable scratch/lustre aliases resolve to subdirectories of that same job root.
cache_isolation.native_file_policy: Third-party cache internals may retain native identifiers only within the ephemeral job directory; public package, return and fetch names and contents retain the deny scan.
cache_isolation.placement: Every cache/temp override points to <ext4 job root>/0/<number>; controller sets this before staging and launch resets every override for both modes. Inherited environment is allowlisted.

policy.native_archives: Preserve all pinned interpreter and third-party package paths and bytes

json_storage: Job metadata and returned JSON/JSONL use a0 hex envelopes. Scans check raw text and JSON-decoded keys/strings (including escaped Unicode). Intentional hex payload decoding occurs only in memory or in the local scorer.
limitations: The CPU rehearsal uses tiny pinned export inputs, a head-shape proof double, and processor/RGB doubles. The clean CPU process uses native libc writable-open auditing, Python mutation auditing and a complete public-tree inventory checked against a fixed allowlist. Direct native syscalls are outside the preload audit; no GPU execution is claimed. GPU computation and native cache contents remain unexecuted; GPU mode uses the same checked cache environment and namespace containment.
logs: Controller, namespace supervisor and worker capture both streams as they arrive into opaque hex journals on job_tmp. Each stream keeps a 16,000-byte tail and caps its journal at 262,144 raw bytes; overflow fails the job. Every return carries both tails. Controller and worker tracebacks retain the last 200 lines, capped at 120 characters per line and 24,000 ASCII bytes, inside a0 hex envelopes. The saved transport stream is also hex-packed.

remaining_external_interfaces.reason: The kernel exposes assigned accelerator devices through this fixed device namespace.
The existing bubblewrap namespace uses this fixed CLI option to expose kernel device nodes.
Slurm supplies CUDA assignment through this fixed NVIDIA interface; its value is still deny-scanned.
Python/native extension import and dynamic-linker ABIs require the upstream library names and contents. Authored sources use the opaque loader; no blanket environment exemption exists.
remaining_external_interfaces.value: Pinned third-party runtime archives and their installed library files: assets.groups, inputs destination d/v

remaining_external_interfaces.reason: Native tokenizer/model readers and export authentication require the exact upstream vocabulary, architecture and tensor identifiers. These immutable external inputs cannot be text-renamed without changing the frozen checkpoint or breaking native readers.
remaining_external_interfaces.value: Pinned external binary checkpoints, RGBs, tokenizer/config/tensor-index files under d/b, d/m400/full_weights, d/f and their unchanged links/copies under d/e/base and d/e/full_weights; original manifest tar under d/o

remaining_external_interfaces.reason: These are the previously placed pinned inputs, authenticated before extraction. They retain original binary contents; retained job metadata is encoded during extraction and excluded roots are never extracted.
remaining_external_interfaces.value: Authenticated external archive bytes temporarily copied into the numeric staging directory

remaining_external_interfaces.reason: Native cache formats may retain library identifiers. Every cache root is opaque and job-local; Orchard teardown removes it. These files are excluded from all public package/return/fetch outputs, and /project is absent from the worker namespace.
remaining_external_interfaces.value: Library-owned cache internals under <ext4 job root>/0/<number> only

source_storage: Every authored source/resource is stored in an a0 hex envelope at a path whose components pass the deny-list. Import names and decoded program text exist only in memory; __file__ uses the opaque path.
